 IN the interaction, not in a policy
Content marking 2 Dec 2026 provider identifier + content ID,
 MINTED AT GENERATION, in ai_decision" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="78" width="600" x="20" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c4b" parent="c4" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1" value="IDENTICAL pattern to China's 标识办法 (显式 + 隐式, GB 45438—2025).
Build one content-marking mechanism, satisfy BOTH regimes.
That is a genuinely strong slide." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="56" width="600" x="20" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="reuse" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=34;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#faf7fc;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontStyle=1;fontSize=13;fontColor=#6b4c85;" value="EXTEND, don't rebuild — what I06 already gives us" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="1740" x="40" y="660" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ru" parent="reuse" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="EU AI Act Article 26 obligation → what we already run status
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
automatic event logging, retain ≥6 months → ai_decision (I06) + OpenTelemetry extend retention
operational human-oversight controls → I06 human_action + OPA action gate (N-12) done, fail closed
technical documentation → model &amp; data register (I06 §3) + MLflow done
discriminatory-impact monitoring → Evidently slice metrics on the I06 scorecard wire up
worker notification → NEW — a UI surface + a per-worker record W07
FRIA where required → NEW — versioned document, named owner W07
incident reporting 24h / 72h / 15d → NEW — one record, three routes, three clocks W01
AI system inventory + risk classification → NEW — the first deliverable W01" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="122" width="1700" x="20" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="multi" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=middle;fontStyle=1" value="ONE control layer, SEVERAL regimes. jurisdiction[] is an array from day one: EU AI Act (strictest) · Colorado AI Act (deployer obligations, 1 Jun 2026) · California CCPA ADMT · and the China set's 标识办法 and PIPL.
Satisfying the EU deployer obligations largely satisfies Colorado and CCPA-ADMT — the sources say so explicitly: it "allows employers to leverage compliance efforts across frameworks."
Step 8 is not optional: AUDIT FOR EMOTION RECOGNITION. Customer-facing sentiment analytics repurposed onto staff — checkout camera analytics, call-centre tone scoring — is ALREADY PROHIBITED." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="1740" x="40" div.div:
STEP 1 — ONE LOOKUP, 16 MONTHS
Was the AI Act Digital Omnibus formally
adopted before 2 August 2026?
YES → high-risk employment obligations
run to 2 Dec 2027
NO → the ORIGINAL August 2026 timeline
applies, and W07 becomes urgent
"Should the Omnibus not be formally adopted
prior to 2 August 2026, the provisions of the
original Act … will take effect."

div.div:
First pass across six folders — engineering drafts it, COUNSEL corrects it:
V02 scheduling · pick-rate monitoring · CV screening → HIGH (Annex III employment)
any staff emotion / sentiment inference → PROHIBITED
N-01 / C07 customer chat → LIMITED (Art. 50)
N-02 / C04 generated content → LIMITED (content marking)
I01 pricing · V03 forecast · I05 data quality → minimal
I04 returns risk · N-10 abuse scoring → ⚠ REVIEW, do not assume

div.div: 2 · THE PROVIDER TRAP NEW

div.div:
"An organisation that SUBSTANTIALLY MODIFIES an existing AI system
or adapts it for a specific high-risk purpose BECOMES THE PROVIDER
in legal terms, and full responsibility for technical documentation
and conformity assessment shifts to that organisation."
Fine-tuning an open model for scheduling could do this.

div.div:
EU AI Act Article 26 obligation → what we already run status
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
automatic event logging, retain ≥6 months → ai_decision (I06) + OpenTelemetry extend retention
operational human-oversight controls → I06 human_action + OPA action gate (N-12) done, fail closed
technical documentation → model & data register (I06 §3) + MLflow done
discriminatory-impact monitoring → Evidently slice metrics on the I06 scorecard wire up
worker notification → NEW — a UI surface + a per-worker record W07
FRIA where required → NEW — versioned document, named owner W07
incident reporting 24h / 72h / 15d → NEW — one record, three routes, three clocks W01
AI system inventory + risk classification → NEW — the first deliverable W01

div.div:
ONE control layer, SEVERAL regimes. jurisdiction[] is an array from day one: EU AI Act (strictest) · Colorado AI Act (deployer obligations, 1 Jun 2026) · California CCPA ADMT · and the China set's 标识办法 and PIPL.
Satisfying the EU deployer obligations largely satisfies Colorado and CCPA-ADMT — the sources say so explicitly: it "allows employers to leverage compliance efforts across frameworks."
Step 8 is not optional: AUDIT FOR EMOTION RECOGNITION. Customer-facing sentiment analytics repurposed onto staff — checkout camera analytics, call-centre tone scoring — is ALREADY PROHIBITED.
